name: Kevin's Natural Foods Korean Style BBQ Steak (Costco 2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Tender strips of beef flank steak prepared sous-vide with coconut aminos, apple cider vinegar, and sesame oil instead of wheat soy sauce or heavy corn syrup. Very tender and easy to chew.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear beef for 2 minutes and pour sauce over. Serve with plain steamed white rice. Skip adding extra raw green onions or sesame seeds if avoiding roughage.
